text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Oka Sho has arrived. It 
feels somewhat strange. I'm not scared at 
all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's going to be okay. Today will 
surely be a race where we get to see a 
wonderful... full bloom of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And once I return... please, grant me some 
time to talk.
